# Vert.x Daemon Monitor - Project Setup

## Project Overview
Maven-based Java project for monitoring Vert.x daemon processes using metrics collection and Prometheus integration.

## Technology Stack
- Java 11+
- Maven 3.6+
- Vert.x 4.5.3
- Micrometer with Prometheus
